Q1: Atrazine exhibits several known hazards (Tier 1) based on GHS classifications, including carcinogenicity, mutagenicity and reproductive toxicity (CMR), acute and chronic environmental hazards (ENV), oral toxicity (ORL), and organ/systemic toxicity (OGN). Q3: Atrazine is an exceptionally well-characterized chemical, with 27,000 scientific literature references, far exceeding the median for petrochemicals.
